description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for different training configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 95000 to 125000, and has tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, ranges from 2.0 to 3.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  

The line representing "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)" is magenta, solid, and begins at approximately 2.90 at an iteration of 95000, decreases to approximately 2.36 at an iteration of 105000, then fluctuates between approximately 2.32 and 2.38 until reaching approximately 2.34 at 125000. The line representing "SepLLM (n=128)" is dark blue, solid, and begins at approximately 2.88 at an iteration of 95000, decreases to approximately 2.38 at an iteration of 105000, then fluctuates between approximately 2.34 and 2.40 until reaching approximately 2.36 at 125000. The line representing "SepLLM (n=64)" is orange, solid, and begins at approximately 2.86 at an iteration of 95000, decreases to approximately 2.37 at an iteration of 105000, then fluctuates between approximately 2.33 and 2.39 until reaching approximately 2.35 at 125000. Finally, the line representing "Vanilla before post-training" is red, dashed, and remains relatively constant at approximately 2.30 across the entire range of iterations, from 95000 to 125000.
